events.relevance: The 2022 diligence could not have initiated the inspection.
Predates the 22 March visit and 6 April diligence.

events.event: Vigilancia Aduanera visit to Sun Park; works and public closure recorded; photographs taken.

propositions.proposition: The complex was undergoing works and closed to the public on 22 March 2022.
propositions.limit: Does not prove the 2017-2018 operating position.

propositions.proposition: An Acosta Matos business-channel contact said that 159 apartments had recently been judicially awarded after a 2017 credit purchase.
propositions.limit: No deed, property schedule or interlocutor identity is annexed.

propositions.proposition: The same channel asserted 2017-2018 Booking advertising, tourist complaints, threats and denied access.
propositions.limit: No Booking record, police complaint, witness statement or adjudication is annexed.

propositions.proposition: The diligence recites a Cabildo tourism history from 1991 through a 2014 change to the Owners' Community.
propositions.source_actor: diligence recital of an unappended Cabildo certificate
propositions.limit: Registration is not by itself proof of actual income receipt or comprehensive operation.

propositions.proposition: Laura Acosta Matos asserted that the 2014 change lacked consent and that Gil Marer continued operating the complex until at least 2018.
propositions.limit: Accuracy, legal capacity, entity attribution, period, revenue and independent corroboration remain open.

propositions.proposition: The source literal refers to a company called GIL MARER.
propositions.source_actor: unnamed male corporate interlocutor as recorded
propositions.limit: Gil Marer is a natural person; Luchy Playa Blanca, S.L.U. is separately named as the company owning the 159 units.

permitted: prove that the identified observations and statements were recorded
test source identity, provenance, independent verification and later AEAT reliance
test entity/function/unit/period/revenue attribution in the Pink dispute
identify the underlying Cabildo certificate, police records, Booking data, title schedules and financial records for production
not_permitted_without_further_evidence: state that the unnamed male was Jose Daniel Acosta Matos
state that every recorded allegation was true or knowingly false
state that the diligence initiated the 2020 inspection or the March 2022 supplementary action
state that Pink was or was not the comprehensive taxable operator solely from this diligence
state criminal intent, retaliation, institutional capture or causal tax effect as established
